parts.text: Open the FinOps dashboard focused on the Cost tab (tab 3) for the it_service_desk agent.
The FinOps & FinOps Analytics Dashboard is now open on Tab 3 (Cost) for agent 'it_service_desk'.
Calculate cache economics for 100,000 prompt tokens with 80,000 cached tokens on gemini-2.5-flash.

For 100,000 prompt tokens with 80,000 cached tokens on gemini-2.5-flash, the cache hit ratio is 80.0%, the cost without caching is $0.03, the cost with caching is $0.0084, and the savings are $0.0216.
Calculate cache economics for 50,000 prompt tokens and 25,000 cached tokens on model gemini-99-experimental.

For 50,000 prompt tokens and 25,000 cached tokens on gemini-99-experimental, the cache hit ratio is 50.0%, but gemini-99-experimental has no rate card (priced is false), so no dollar costs or savings are priced.

Run a Prompt Cache X-Ray comparing these two prompts on gemini-2.5-flash at 10,000 monthly requests:
Previous prompt:
You are an enterprise IT support agent.
Current time: 2026-04-19T10:00:00Z
Always follow corporate security policy section 4.2 and verify ticket numbers before escalating.

Current prompt:
You are an enterprise IT support agent.
Current time: 2026-04-19T10:05:00Z
Always follow corporate security policy section 4.2 and verify ticket numbers before escalating.

Prompt Cache X-Ray detected a cache breakpoint at line 2 caused by the dynamic timestamp ('Current time: ...') preceding the static security policy block. Moving the volatile timestamp to the end of the prompt restores prefix caching.

Use detect_prompt_breakpoint to find the exact line and reason where caching broke between these two prompts:
Previous prompt:
System role: FinOps analyst
Policy v1
Request ID: req-101

Current prompt:
System role: FinOps analyst
Policy v1
Request ID: req-202
The prompt prefix cache broke at line 3 where 'Request ID: req-101' changed to 'Request ID: req-202'.
Run one AlphaEvolve cycle for the it_service_desk agent and tell me what happened.

Ran one generation of the built-in optimizer simulator on the it_service_desk demo profile. Note that this is a simulator: the numbers are synthetic and nothing was deployed or modified in production.
Run the deterministic telemetry grounding audit without the LLM judge and summarize the verification status.
Executed validate_telemetry_grounding(run_llm_judge=False) and reported the deterministic telemetry grounding checks and verification status.
Call query_ge_agent_fleet for a 24-hour window and report the total registered Gemini Enterprise agents and unregistered runtimes found.
Queried the Gemini Enterprise agent fleet over the 24-hour window and reported the registered GE agents, unregistered runtimes, and observed telemetry totals from the tool output.
Call query_live_finops_and_mart for the last 7 days and summarize the BigQuery mart insights and billing reconciliation status.
Queried the BigQuery Gemini Enterprise reporting mart (finops_mart) and Cloud Billing export reconciliation for the 7-day window and summarized the observed sessions, token usage, and billing status.
Call list_cloud_run_agents and list the deployed Cloud Run agent services in this project.
Listed the deployed Cloud Run services in the hosting Google Cloud project along with their regions and URLs.
Call query_gcp_telemetry with hours_ago=24 and report the project ID and telemetry summary.
Queried the last 24 hours of GCP telemetry and reported the project ID, active services, and ingested turn statistics from the tool output.
